record.question: Which state in India is known as the 'Land of Five Rivers'?
record.explanation: Answer C: Punjab. Punjab is the Land of Five Rivers. Its state government explains the name from five and water and identifies the five historical rivers; only three now pass through the Indian state. Historical/source note: Traditional name of historical Punjab; not a claim that all five rivers lie within today's Indian state. Reference: https://punjab.gov.in/know-punjab/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
